blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – Residents of Baroro, a coastal barangay in Bacnotan, La Union, have asked police and animal welfare groups to look into what appeared to be a rampant poisoning of dogs in their community. Baroto has been alarmed after three dogs and a duck were found sprawled dead early Monday at the property of the Jabontinalla family. Adrian Jabonitalla, 24, was awakened by his uncle Levy’s calls, telling him that Blaky, one of the family’s puppies, had been found dead in the yard.
